assembly.gable: row0: SL, ridge_cap x n, SR | row1: SL, mid x (n+2), SR | row2: eave_left, eave_mid x (n+4), eave_right (each lower row is two tiles wider)
assembly.stilts: foundation_beam_left, beam_mid.., beam_right under the wall; stilt_post_top / stilt_post / stilt_foot stacked below; braces between legs
assembly.wall: TL T..T TR / L C..C R / BL B..B BR; swap centres for the variants; put a window tile or the 16x32 door over a centre tile
